correctness.rationale: For exactly the Fraïssé separation-reduct quotient with 2-element F-classes, homogeneous one-point extensions are unordered gap pairs modulo pointwise dihedral stabilizer. There are C(2m+1,2) raw placements and m equality types. An adjacent-pair labeled diagram has trivial stabilizer for m>=3, attaining 2m(m+1); m=1 gives 2 nonalgebraic types, m=2 gives max 7 nonalgebraic types. Independently enumerated all perfect matchings through m=5: full maxima [3,9,24,40,60], consistent with inspected verifier covering m<=6; infinite m>=3 comes from stabilizer argument, not extrapolation. Caveat: oriented circular-order example is a richer object; result scoped to separation quotient only.
